name: build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "!.github/**"
      - ".github/workflows/build.yaml"
      - "!docs/**"
      - "!examples/**"
      - "!images/**"
      - "!**.md"
      - "!**.ipynb"
      - "resources/**"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "!.github/**"
      - ".github/workflows/build.yaml"
      - "!docs/**"
      - "!examples/**"
      - "!images/**"
      - "!**.md"
      - "!**.ipynb"
      - "resources/**"
  # manual trigger
  workflow_dispatch: { }
env:
  # Decide crate freshness by file checksums, not mtimes, so that unchanged workspace crates
  # restored from the cache are reused after `actions/checkout` resets all mtimes
  CARGO_UNSTABLE_CHECKSUM_FRESHNESS: "true"
  RUST_LOG: "debug"
  RUST_LOG_SPAN_EVENTS: "new,close"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: "1"
  # Note: embed a tiny folder only to test the "web-ui" feature building
  KAMU_WEB_UI_DIR: "../../../.github"
jobs:
  lint_fmt:
    name: Lint / Code
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: false
      - uses: cargo-bins/cargo-binstall@main
      - name: cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check
      - name: cargo sort
        run: |
          cargo binstall cargo-sort -y
          cargo sort -g -w -n -c
      - name: taplo fmt
        run: |
          cargo binstall taplo-cli -y
          taplo fmt --check
      - name: Lint dividing lines
        run: cargo test -p kamu-repo-tools -- dividing_lines
      - name: Lint license headers
        run: cargo test -p kamu-repo-tools -- license_header
      - name: Lint OpenAPI spec
        run: make lint-openapi
      - name: clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

  lint_codegen:
    name: Lint / Codegen
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: kamu-data/kamu-cli
          path: kamu-cli
      - name: Copy rust-toolchain file
        run: cp kamu-cli/rust-toolchain.toml ./rust-toolchain.toml
      - name: Read pinned ODF spec version
        id: odf
        run: echo "ref=$(make -s -C kamu-cli print-odf-spec-ref)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-data-fabric/open-data-fabric
          ref: ${{ steps.odf.outputs.ref }}
          path: open-data-fabric
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
          cache: false
      # We use nix flake to install flatc, protoc and other tools needed for codegen
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - uses: cachix/cachix-action@v16
        with:
          name: kamu
          authToken: "${{ secrets.CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN }}"
      - name: Generate artifacts
        run: |
          cd kamu-cli
          nix develop ./images/nix-dev -c make codegen
      - name: Check generated files
        run: cd kamu-cli && git diff && git diff-index --quiet HEAD

  lint_deps:
    name: Lint / Dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          cache: false
      - uses: cargo-bins/cargo-binstall@main
      - run: cargo binstall cargo-deny -y
      - run: cargo deny check --hide-inclusion-graph
      - run: cargo binstall cargo-udeps -y
      - run: cargo udeps --

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
